title: Siya Ram v. State of U.P. — recovery citation; liberty under clause 6.14
coram: Krishna Murari, J.; Amar Singh Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; liberty to represent under clause 6.14.
headnote: A writ challenging a recovery citation for electricity dues, the consumer offering to pay in instalments, is disposed of with liberty to represent under clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Executive Engineer, DGM and General Manager may grant instalment facility to consumers in financial distress; the representation is to be decided in accordance with law, preferably within one month.
facts: Siya Ram challenged a 23 June 2015 citation issued by respondent no. 2 for recovery of Rs.1,68,556 towards electricity consumption. He offered to deposit the entire sum in instalments. Counsel for the Corporation pointed out that clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 empowers the Executive Engineer, DGM and General Manager to grant instalments to consumers in financial distress, and that the petitioner could approach those authorities with a representation.

holding_units.holding: Clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 empowers the Executive Engineer, DGM and General Manager to extend instalment facility to consumers in financial distress. A writ challenging a recovery citation, where the consumer offers to pay in instalments, is disposed of with liberty to represent under that clause; the authority shall decide the representation in accordance with law, preferably within one month.

not_decided.point: validity of the recovery citation and whether instalments should be granted
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the 23.06.2015 citation on merits and left entitlement to instalments to the clause 6.14 authority.
